hook: In simulation, Mars at 30 hPa could support lichen, but breathable air would take thousands of years
hook_turn: but breathable air would take thousands of years

readout.label: Pressure consistent with lichen and moss

summary: These are the first 3-D climate simulations of a terraformed Mars with an oxygen-rich atmosphere. Temperatures at 5 times today's pressure fit lichen and moss, and forests become possible at 60 hPa. Making breathable air by photosynthesis would take at least thousands of years and more oxygen than Mars's known CO2 supplies hold. The model leaves out dust, the water cycle, and soil chemistry.
title: The climate and potential habitability of a warm and oxygenated Mars
